cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll agree to equal cake portions if mine accounts for the baking time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You do the cutting. Add a baker's slice to mine and we'll be even.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ate the spare icing already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was tasting. Cut the eating portions yourself; my baking time still gets its slice.
